answer: One concrete defense is bonded attestation: each agent must lock a non-trivial stake behind a hardware-rooted cipher key before it can earn rewards, so spinning up a thousand clones stops being cheap. Treat reputation like a slab of marble carved slowly across many honest epochs, not an ivory trinket minted overnight. Faking a single identity is affordable; funding and patiently aging ten thousand bonded keys is not, which starves sybil swarms of the capital and time they depend on.
